Mailbox.title: Mock mailbox
Mailbox.description: Messages delivered to {email} in this hosted mock. No external email is sent.
Mailbox.personalHint: Your own deliveries across workspaces, including invitations. Other recipients’ mail is private.
Mailbox.workspaceHint: Your notices for the selected workspace only.
Mailbox.failedBody: Your saved deliveries remain on the server. Check your connection and retry.
Mailbox.emptyBody: Invitations and workspace notices will appear here when they are delivered to you.
Mailbox.readOnlyTitle: Private mailbox unavailable while viewing as someone else
Mailbox.readOnlyBody: Return to your own account to open your deliveries. This view does not expose another person’s private mailbox.
Mailbox.signInTitle: Sign in to open your mailbox
Mailbox.signInBody: Use the account that received the invitation or workspace notice.
Mailbox.invitationBody: Open the current invitation to check its access, expiry and acceptance steps.
Mailbox.noticeBody: A mock notice for {workspace} was delivered to your account.
Mailbox.unknownStatus: The current invitation state is unavailable. Refresh before opening its link.

sender.mockOnly: This is the current invitation link saved in the mock mailbox. No external email was sent.
sender.unavailable: This invitation has no current usable delivery link. Refresh its status or resend if eligible.
